analyze_upgrade_pattern.ec_enhancement: Add analysis/interpretation layer — connect calculation result to business action, add comparative framework, explain what a manager would DO with the variance insight

p1b_c_108.ec_plan: Connect volume variance to fixed cost behavior; explain underapplied overhead
p1b_c_108.dist_plan: Upgrade from calculation errors to interpretation errors (sign reversal → misreading direction of underproduction)

p1b_c_109.ec_plan: Explain four-way decomposition structure; connect to production manager accountability
p1b_c_109.dist_plan: Interpretation errors: confusing favorable/unfavorable meaning, wrong accountable manager

p1b_c_111.ec_plan: Decompose yield to output loss %; connect to mix variance interaction

p1b_c_112.ec_plan: Analyze substitution incentive (using more expensive material); flag for operations review
p1b_c_112.dist_plan: Partial-mix thinking: seeing one material's favorable without netting the other

p1b_c_114.ec_plan: Skilled vs unskilled substitution: was quality worth the cost? Mix as policy signal
p1b_c_114.dist_plan: Confusing mix with total variance, ignoring net effect of both labor grades

p1b_c_118.ec_plan: Quality-of-sales insight: flat volume but improved mix = premium product push success
p1b_c_118.dist_plan: Capturing only one product's favorable portion without netting the unfavorable

p1b_c_119.ec_plan: 12.5% shortfall analysis: demand weak? competitor? production failure?
p1b_c_119.dist_plan: Reversing sign (thinking lower volume = less spending, a cost-variance confusion)

p1b_c_120.ec_plan: Share gain PLUS market growth = outperformance. Decompose share vs size effects
p1b_c_120.dist_plan: Confusing share variance with size variance bases

p1b_c_121.ec_plan: Rising tide lifts all boats — but separately, did we outperform? Paired analysis with share
p1b_c_121.dist_plan: Forgetting to apply budgeted share % to total market growth

p1b_c_143.ec_plan: EVA=32K means value created. Compare ROCE vs WACC. What if WACC were 16%?
p1b_c_143.dist_plan: Using gross assets instead of net invested capital; confusing pre-tax with after-tax

p1b_c_154.ec_plan: At full capacity, minimum TP = market price. But should buyer pay it? Firm-wide optimization
p1b_c_154.dist_plan: Adding outlay + market price (double-counting); averaging (no theoretical basis)

p1b_c_184.ec_plan: Sensitivity: at 30% probability, break-even. Intangible benefits of investigation
p1b_c_184.dist_plan: Confusing gross benefit with net EV; confusing investigation cost with not-investigating value

p1b_d_095.ec_plan: Compare FIFO vs WA. FIFO gives purer measure of CURRENT period. Manager preference
p1b_d_095.dist_plan: Ignoring ending WIP; treating beginning WIP as 100% complete this period

p1b_d_098.ec_plan: FIFO rate reflects THIS period's efficiency only. Compare to prior period for cost creep signal
p1b_d_098.dist_plan: Mixing periods: including BWIP costs in numerator but FIFO EU in denominator

p1b_d_112.ec_plan: NRV hides unprofitability — it's allocation, not profitability signal. Sell-or-process-further is the correct tool
p1b_d_112.dist_plan: Using physical-units ratio instead of NRV; using gross sales value instead of NRV

p1b_d_119.ec_plan: Sequence dependency is biggest weakness. Compare Admin-first vs IT-first results. Only reciprocal resolves
p1b_d_119.dist_plan: Forgetting that closed dept receives allocations from prior depts; allocating back to closed dept

p1b_d_120.ec_plan: Compare direct vs step-down vs reciprocal. When does precision justify complexity?
p1b_d_120.dist_plan: Attributing one department's fully-allocated cost to the wrong department name

p1b_d_138.ec_plan: BE is FUNCTION of sales mix. If mix shifts to lower-CM product, BE rises. Manager must understand this
p1b_d_138.dist_plan: Using single product's CM instead of weighted-average; assuming all units are X or all are Y

p1_cd_009.ec_plan: From definition to analytical context: who is responsible? When is it actionable?
p1_cd_009.dist_plan: Confusing cost-side with revenue-side variances; confusing spending with efficiency

p1_cd_033.ec_plan: Incentive-best but accounting-complex. Both sides willing to transact. Consolidation elimination needed
p1_cd_033.dist_plan: Thinking dual-rate eliminates need for policy; matching market vs resolving VC vs FC conflict

p1_cd_042.ec_plan: Production manager investigates quantity, but root cause may be purchasing manager. Attribution nuance
p1_cd_042.dist_plan: Confusing price variance owner with quantity variance owner
